name: Custom Shape Wooden Pen and Glasses Holder
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a sturdy, lightweight, and decorative storage solution for desks and study spaces.
    - Made from 3mm thick wooden panels, creating a durable structure while keeping the holder easy to assemble and use.
    - Designed in a charming custom owl shape, adding a playful and eye-catching touch to your workspace.
    - Built with multiple functional sections, including a pen holder, glasses support, and phone stand.
    - The natural wooden structure combines practicality with a warm handcrafted look.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 7 x 7 x 7 in ~ 17.78 x 17.78 x 17.78 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed. 
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - All main structural pieces are printed on both sides for a polished finished look.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a desk organizer, pen holder, glasses stand, and phone stand in one compact design.
    - Helps keep workspaces neat while adding a decorative and personalized touch.
    - Suitable for school desks, office desks, study tables, teacher desks, and home workstations.
    - Great for organizing daily essentials such as pens, markers, scissors, eyeglasses, and phones.
    - Designed for both decorative display and everyday practical use.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for teachers, students, kids, coworkers, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Teacher Appreciation Day, back-to-school gifts, birthdays, holidays, graduation gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves cute desk accessories, animal-themed décor, and personalized organizers.
    - Great for classroom use, office desks, study corners, and children's learning spaces.
    - A useful and decorative gift that combines storage, organization, and playful design.
    - Adds a fun, charming, and practical touch to any desk setup 🦉🎁

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
